assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY is the repository-maintained provisional rough polygon, not an official planning boundary. Issue #846 reports a reproducible 412.5 m separation from an OSM-mapped built section of the heritage park; neither source is promoted to an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All coordinates and spatial ratios are temporary container calculations. Official polygons trigger full-package recalculation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Organizer-supplied, rights-cleared official SITE_BOUNDARY with CRS and version metadata.

assumptions.statement: The three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough envelopes calibrated from names, order, and approximate announced areas.
assumptions.impact: Detailed designs describe transferable prototypes and cannot support parcel decisions.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, green-ratio, setbacks, road redlines, municipal capacities, fire controls, and statutory four-lines are missing.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity or engineering conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Surveyed buildings, floor counts, conditions, tenure, occupancy, and ownership are unavailable. BUILDING_FOOTPRINT features are conceptual program envelopes only.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish decisions remain a decision tree; no individual building is assigned for demolition.

assumptions.statement: Road sections, crossing conditions, station interfaces, parking counts, traffic demand, and emergency access baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: ROAD_CENTERLINE features are conceptual connectivity tests, not alignments or construction drawings.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries and the implemented heritage-park design package are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks are reversible, low-ground-contact concepts and require heritage authority review.

assumptions.statement: The Xueyuan South Road–Zhichun Road community-vitality section is used as a representative segment because current Beijing government reporting verifies its restored rails, east-side slow route, acoustic barrier, embankment adaptation and neighborhood context. The OSM snapshot supplies orientation only; neither source supplies the exact siting of the proposed intervention.
assumptions.impact: The site-grounding figure and site-constrained image may guide material, direction and operational logic, but cannot authorize a parcel, crossing, robot route, pavilion footprint or construction detail.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Rights-cleared official survey/base map, heritage and tenure boundaries, exact access points, traffic/accessibility baseline, and accountable approvals for a selected location.

assumptions.statement: Every scenario is a proposed operating protocol. Non-AI equivalence, human staffing, stop authority, response time, and accessibility performance must be verified in a time-limited pilot.
assumptions.impact: No service or event is described as approved or funded.

assumptions.statement: The Slowest-User Test categories are a starting hypothesis, not a substitute for participation by disabled people, older residents, children, carers, workers, and language minorities.
assumptions.impact: User thresholds and spatial details must be co-designed and can veto deployment.

assumptions.statement: Participant-collected official policies and global case pages are recorded in package sources.json. Absence from the maintainer-owned central registry is neither central approval nor prohibition.
assumptions.impact: They support policy/case reasoning only, never site-specific controls.

assumptions.statement: Global case studies are qualitative mechanism comparisons based on public institutional pages.
assumptions.impact: No unverified investment, output, company, or performance number is used as a Haidian target.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day All-Stop Gate is an unlocated hand-off protocol. Its site, rights holder, accessibility co-design partner, operator, safety/privacy professionals, independent reviewer, opening hours, sample, thresholds, staffing and costs are all unassigned or unknown.
assumptions.impact: The three study windows and six evidence gates can organize later work but authorize no procurement, data collection, public trial, robot operation or construction. Field thresholds must be preregistered with affected participants and professionals.

assumptions.statement: simulation.json contains a fixed offline synthetic task ledger. It uses no online model, real robot, public road, participant, personal data or field measurement.
assumptions.impact: Its success, schema and audit ratios demonstrate reproducible contract handling only. They cannot support claims about accessibility, human response, robot safety, service quality or public acceptance in the real site.

assumptions.statement: P0-ALL-STOP-01 dimensions are transparent concept-screening assumptions derived from the stated 18 m x 12 m envelope and component relationships. They are not copied from another submission, are not site measurements, and are not claimed as statutory or signed engineering minima.
assumptions.impact: They support clash checks, quantity derivation, and hand-off only. Every site- and standard-sensitive parameter remains subject to competent professional review.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Candidate site survey, applicable public-standard confirmation, paid accessibility co-design, equipment selection, or any geometry change.

assumptions.statement: P0-CAND-01 binds the participant-preferred screening relationship to the provisional Zhongzhiyuan key area and safe-speed-yard spatial object. It still has no coordinates, parcel, rights holder, measured section, emergency baseline, utilities, drainage, lighting, noise, or microclimate record.
assumptions.impact: Authorization stays NOT_AUTHORIZED and every field metric stays HOLD. The candidate relation improves hand-off specificity but is not a site plan or selection decision.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Authorized candidate-site baseline and rights/heritage/fire/utilities review.

assumptions.statement: All seventeen referenced execution, accountability, accessibility, traffic, fire, structure, electrical, drainage, equipment, lighting, maintenance, stop, human-takeover, installation, survey, co-design, and independent-evaluation role slots are declared but unassigned/conditional.
assumptions.impact: No gate may open, no public operation may begin, and no restoration may be accepted until written role acceptance and authority limits are recorded.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Written acceptance by real competent parties without implying government authorization.

assumptions.statement: The BOQ contains concept-derived quantities only. v1.4 adds CNY participant working bands for CAPEX ROM and annual OPEX, with a fixed basis date, while every market unit rate, quotation entity, formal estimate, tender price, tax basis and funding commitment remains null/TBC.
assumptions.impact: The bands support option and roster sensitivity comparison but are not a price, budget, supplier quotation, cost-professional estimate, or funding claim.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Nominated site, verified quantities, neutral procurement route, auditable market rates, professional cost plan, and funding authority.

assumptions.statement: The two-layer acceptance matrix distinguishes eight package-checkable items from twelve field-dependent metrics. v1.4 closes the audit-record and AI-off staffed-service rehearsal gaps, so current package results are eight PASS and zero HOLD; all twelve field metrics remain HOLD. v1.5 aggregates those twelve raw metrics and twelve external gates into four decision bundles without removing any evidence requirement.
assumptions.impact: Synthetic tasks, concept paths, and fictional journeys cannot be presented as wheelchair, low-vision, older-person, response-time, conflict, environmental, acceptance, roster, or real-cost performance.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: G0-G3 evidence, paid co-design preregistration, authorized field data, named operator, and independent evaluation.

assumptions.statement: The 1.8 m turning assumption and all tactile, contrast, service-desk, response, and group thresholds must be tested with paid affected participants and accessibility professionals.
assumptions.impact: Concept dimensions cannot substitute for lived-experience acceptance or professional compliance review.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Accessible full-size mock-up and participant-approved task protocol.

assumptions.statement: v1.4 compares 8, 12 and 18 public-service hours per day using 1680 productive hours per FTE-year and a 1.2 leave/training factor. The selected 12-hour middle working case assumes 07:00-19:00, covers morning-to-evening civic use more fully than the 8-hour fallback without treating the 18-hour stress case as authorized, calculates 3.129 FTE, and rounds to a four-FTE roster with zero modelled uncovered hours.
assumptions.impact: The roster makes the human-equivalent rule computable but does not create a named operator, employment commitment, insurance, funding, or opening permission.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A named operator confirms service hours, productive-hour rules, simultaneous staffing, leave, training, hot backup, insurance and budget.

assumptions.statement: v1.5 provides seven bilingual execution forms, eighteen common evidence-receipt fields, four external decision bundles, a machine mirror, and a deterministic verifier. All forms are blank and current verified external records remain zero.
assumptions.impact: The package is directly receivable by survey, operations, professional-review, cost, procurement, maintenance and independent-evaluation teams, but form completeness does not prove execution maturity.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A competent party completes, signs and independently reviews an executed copy with traceable external evidence.

assumptions.statement: The participant capacity rule is the minimum of surveyed net-area capacity, approved fire/life-safety capacity, accessible-service-position capacity, and appointed staffed-role coverage. Two independent egress routes are a concept design test only; field-verified routes and widths remain zero/null.
assumptions.impact: No occupancy, opening, event or evacuation claim can be made until survey, fire, accessibility and operator evidence is accepted.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Authorized survey plus fire/life-safety, accessibility and named-operator confirmation.

assumptions.statement: v1.5 defines four maintenance cycles and a restoration-reserve sensitivity of 10%–20% of verified removable CAPEX plus site-specific restoration, removal transport, waste treatment and independent closeout. Verified CAPEX, reserve amount and ring-fenced funding remain null/false.
assumptions.impact: Maintenance and removal become explicit decision interfaces without presenting a participant percentage as a cost estimate or funded reserve.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Verified quantities and costs, named maintenance responsibility, site-specific restoration method, funding authority and independent closeout acceptance.
